marks.gloss_en: ואיבעית אימא: לעולם כרב הונא -- per Rav Chisda the first animal would not be singled out
for were it per Rav Chisda -- since we merely attribute the notch, why to the first animal's neck-bone? perhaps it was the last's
the quarantined house: the mark may have shrunk as he left, yet he quarantines -- chazaka
Lev 14:38 -- the priest leaves the house and quarantines it; perhaps as he left the mark shrank below its size! rather, because we say: establish it on its presumption
perhaps he exits backwards and sees it (= p_yetzia_achorav; Abaye's refutations are answered by Rava, the baraita is re-read -- left unrefuted)
Rav Acha bar Yaakov: perhaps he exits walking backwards, seeing the mark as he goes
ומאי שנא? -- why should a doubt of pausing differ from the knife's doubt (aimed at the previous answer)
there the flaw arose in the animal; here in the knife, not the animal (= p_hatam_reiuta_bivhema, p_sakin_itrea)
there (pausing / pressing) the flaw arose in the animal
אלא במאי איפגים? -- if no bone was broken, what notched it but the hide?
אימא: בעצם דמפרקת איפגים (= p_etzem_demafreket)
והלכתא כוותיה דרב הונא כשלא שיבר בה עצם
והלכתא כוותיה דרב חסדא כששיבר בה עצם
the halakha follows Rav Huna where he broke no bone with it: invalid
אי הכי, תיבעי נמי בדיקת חכם! -- then each check should need a sage
עד אחד נאמן באיסורין (= p_ed_echad_neeman)
אי הכי, מעיקרא נמי לא! -- then the first check should not need a sage either
האמר רבי יוחנן: only for the sage's honour (= p_ryochanan_kvod_chacham)
one witness is believed in matters of prohibition
Abaye, first answer: exiting backwards is not called exiting
Abaye, second answer: and behind the door? וכי תימא he opens a window -- והתנן a dark house: no windows are opened to see its mark
the mishna: in a dark house one does not open windows to see its mark
Rava: the High Priest on Yom Kippur proves otherwise -- 'exit' is written of him, and the mishna says he came out the way he entered (p_mishna_yoma_derech_knisato)
Rava: that applies where the mark was not yet established; where it was established, it was established
the mishna (Yoma): the High Priest exited and came out the way he had entered (facing inward)
תניא דלא כרב אחא בר יעקב: from his own house, or inside the house, the quarantine holds -- without seeing
there was a case, and Rav Yosef declared as many as thirteen animals tereifot
Rav Kahana required checking the knife between each and every slaughter
establish a matter on its presumptive status
the baraita: not from his own house ('to the entrance'), not under the lintel ('from the house') -- he stands beside the lintel and quarantines
and if he went into his own house, or stood inside the house, and quarantined -- his quarantine holds: 'and he shall quarantine the house', in any case
